svg.title: Cannon Quest — project card
svg.desc: Load operation orbs into the cannon, fire, and free x from its cage. A drag-to-load 2D algebra game with a guided tutorial and full localisation. Built with Javascript, Gsap, I18N. Live demo. Banner: the game's real title screen.
